I had a fascinating conversation with Brett and Zach, the masterminds behind Coco Note, an AI notetaker that skyrocketed in popularity among college students. In just 18 months, they went from launching the app to being acquired by Quizlet. 

They shared how they used TikTok not to chase views, but to target the right audience effectively, leading them to 6.7 million ARR. They built a team of part-time creators who really understood their product and audience, which was crucial to their success. We also discussed how they improved trial conversion by 16% and implemented an anti-churn tactic that kept 27% of users from canceling. 

If you're curious about how they achieved such rapid growth and the specific strategies they used, you're going to want to hear this. Plus, there's a free AI tool that can help optimize your app's paywall. Check the description for more details.
